oracleCameraContract.source: Google Earth Pro Mars native render contract
oracleCameraContract.qualification: 201 native headless samples; licensed ESO pixels replace Google sky bytes

pointSourcePresentation.source: Google Earth Pro Mars fixed-size catalogue draw contract
pointSourcePresentation.positionSource: licensed ESO photographic local maxima; no Google catalogue bytes
pointSourcePresentation.qualification: native fixed-size catalogue behavior collapsed into the prepared cubemap; point positions and colors remain ESO-derived

sky.qualification: source-photographed full sky; orientation is registered to Galactic coordinates but no observer epoch or Mars ephemeris is claimed; no Sun is baked into the cubemap

analyticRadialFit.qualification: Least-squares fit to annular red-channel means from the bound native 128 by 128 Sun texture; fitted values only, no source pixels.

distanceScaling.qualification: The opaque photospheric core is projected from the IAU nominal solar radius and the object catalog's mean heliocentric distance. The retained glow profile remains a visual presentation; the distance is not epoch-specific.

defaultCameraBinding.qualification: Fully visible native Sun pose recovered from the exact Sun model-view translation and bound to the default cssEarth camera.

controls.label: Visible color
controls.description: USGS Viking MDIM 2.1 global mosaic, colorized with NASA Ames processing. Source sampling is about 1 km; resolution and photographed lighting vary. This assembled historical map does not depict the scene date.
controls.title: MDIM 2.1 colorized global mosaic
controls.summary: Surface detail comes from Viking images with NASA Ames color. Lighting and resolution vary; these are archival observations.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Mars Global Surveyor MOLA topography shown with the source pseudo-color shaded-relief palette. Colors indicate relative elevation, with cartographic shading; this is a prepared global display mosaic, not a current photograph or numeric height readout.
controls.title: MOLA global color shaded relief
controls.summary: Colors describe terrain height and shading reveals slopes. This published relief image does not provide a numeric readout.

controls.label: Thermal infrared
controls.description: USGS/ASU THEMIS daytime infrared brightness mosaic from Mars Odyssey. Gray grid marks unavailable source coverage; dark interior samples remain. No Viking imagery fills thermal gaps. Multiple observations are combined; this is not a temperature map or the scene date.
controls.title: THEMIS daytime infrared mosaic
controls.summary: Brightness records daytime infrared imagery, not a temperature reading. The gray grid marks gaps left unfilled.
